name: GAN330 Keychain Cube 3x3
description: The GAN 330 Keychain Cube is the perfect 3x3 for on-the-go cubers. It is built just like a speedcube, so no need to sacrifice performance for portability. With adjustable tensions and honeycomb contact surfaces, this puzzle has almost everything flagship puzzles have! Show off your speedcubing skills anywhere you go with the high-performance GAN 330 Keychain Cube!
